why: CCER registry ccer.cets.org.cn: the public API lists the project, but /api/file/download/single redirects to /redirectpage and /api/download returns 401 (login needed). CSSC Haizhuang (hzwindpower.com) grid-connection news gives no height. MSA notices for generator/blade replacements (js.msa.gov.cn) give only coordinates. Nantong ecology bureau still 403; hbj.nantong.gov.cn does not resolve here.

note_zh: 線索：搜尋摘要顯示三峽大豐 800 MW 招標文件寫 H8-1 場址水深 9–18 m、H9 與 H15 7–15 m、H17 0–15 m（全案約 0–18 m），但三峽採購平台、北極星與龍船風電網在此都連不上，無法核對；主力機型 GWH230-8.5 與 GW191-6 的輪轂高度未查到（13.6 MW 單機 142 m 只屬 1 台）。
note_en: Lead: search snippets of the CTG Dafeng 800 MW tender give depths of 9–18 m (H8-1), 7–15 m (H9, H15) and 0–15 m (H17), about 0–18 m overall, but the CTG procurement site, bjx and imarine are unreachable here, so unverified; hub heights of the GWH230-8.5 and GW191-6 units not found (the 142 m hub belongs to the single 13.6 MW unit).
why: eps.ctg.com.cn and sidri.com (CTG design institute) cut TLS; news.bjx.com.cn WAF challenge; wind.imarine.cn 403; hynyw.com 503. Goldwind, Dafeng district, Xinhua and SASAC reports name only the 13.6 MW unit's hub. Not in the CCER registry.

note_en: Lead: registered in the national CCER registry (CHN Energy Jiangsu Dongtai H2 phase IV 300 MW); its PDD probably gives both models' hub heights, but downloads need a login. A CHN Energy tender (Apr 2026) confirms 63 Shanghai Electric 4.0 MW + 12 Envision 4.2 MW units.
why: ccer.cets.org.cn downloads need login; hbt.jiangsu.gov.cn (old Jiangsu ecology domain with the 2021-03-24 acceptance publicity) no longer resolves and sthjt.jiangsu.gov.cn returns 404 for that article; the Dongtai X3 cable EIA on jshbgz.cn describes the farm but gives no hub height (and is AES-encrypted, so check_quotes cannot read it).
issues: Foundation: the farm is recorded as monopile ('mp'), but the operator's 2026 tender says units 47# and 66# stand on high-rise pile caps (高桩承台) and the rest on monopiles, i.e. 2 of 75 units are not monopiles.

issue_sources.quote: 共有上海电气、远景2个厂家2种机型（上海电气4.0MW风机63台、远景4.2MW风机12台），其中47#、66#风机为高桩承台，其他为单桩基础。

farm: Jiangsu Dongtai Zhugensha H1 Offshore wind farm
note_zh: 線索：《中國能源報》（2020-06-22）寫東台五期（竹根沙H1#）「拟安装50台上海电气4.0-146/95风力发电机组」，型號尾碼 95 依上海電氣命名慣例應是輪轂高度，但這是型號、且是「擬安裝」，不採用；同文「第三支叶片在百米高空与轮毂稳稳对接」是吊裝高度。葉輪 146 m 的明文（國際風力發電網）在此 403。
note_en: Lead: China Energy News (22 Jun 2020) says Dongtai phase V (Zhugensha H1#) 'is to install 50 Shanghai Electric 4.0-146/95 turbines'; the /95 suffix is the hub height by Shanghai Electric's naming, but it is a model code in planning wording, so not used; the same article's 'blade docked with the hub at a hundred metres' is an installation height. The page stating the 146 m rotor (in-en.com) is 403 here.
why: Hub only implied by a model suffix; m.in-en.com / wind.in-en.com 403; bioffshore.com and offshorecable.com.cn 503. The 2025–2026 EIA of the Zhugensha Z1 offshore-PV project inside this farm (jshbgz.cn) is only on Baidu Pan. Not in the CCER registry.
issues: The turbine field is empty; the source gives 50 × Shanghai Electric 4.0-146 (4 MW). It also confirms that Guohua Dongtai phase V is this farm (竹根沙H1#).

why: news.bjx.com.cn WAF challenge; zhuanlan.zhihu.com 403; news.qq.com 501; ne21 tender gives design-stage depths only. Not in the CCER registry.
